name: Training Ray Compositing (Backward)
definition: A CUDA kernel that computes gradients for density (`sigmas`) and color (`rgbs`) during volume rendering backpropagation. It uses the chain rule to propagate gradients from the final image and weights sum back to the sample points.
summary: Training Ray Compositing (Backward) computes gradients of the volume rendering loss with respect to density and color parameters by propagating gradients from the final image back to individual sample points along each ray.
